related_questions.question: What is the main cause of death in Iran?

text_blocks.snippet: In Iran, cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) are the leading cause of death. Following CVDs, cancers, respiratory diseases, and unintentional injuries are also major contributors to mortality. These findings are consistent across various studies and reports on mortality in Iran.

list.title: Cardiovascular Diseases:
list.snippet: CVDs, including heart disease and stroke, account for a significant portion of deaths in Iran, with some sources indicating it's the leading cause.

list.title: Cancers:
list.snippet: Various types of cancers are also a major cause of death in Iran, ranking among the top causes.

list.title: Respiratory Diseases:
list.snippet: Respiratory illnesses, such as lower respiratory tract infections, also contribute significantly to mortality rates in Iran.

list.title: Unintentional Injuries:
list.snippet: Motor vehicle accidents and other unintentional injuries are a notable cause of death, especially among younger populations.

text_blocks.snippet: These findings highlight the importance of addressing both non-communicable diseases like CVDs and cancers, as well as external causes like injuries, in public health initiatives in Iran.
